findings.reason: src/renderer.ts:308-323 now handles only text/image/html/breaks, so code_inline tokens hit the `default` skip branch. The image rule at src/renderer.ts:108-109 builds alt from renderInlineAsText, so `![`diagram`](d.png)` now gives alt="" instead of alt="diagram". That breaks the CommonMark plain-text alt behaviour the method's own doc comment (lines 295-297) says it exists for.
findings.claim: Removing the code_inline case from renderInlineAsText drops inline code from image alt text.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes `case 'code_inline':` and its comment "code content is added as plain text, without backticks" from the switch in `renderInlineAsText`. A code_inline token now falls through to `default: // all other tokens are skipped` (lines 322-323), so its content is never appended. `renderInlineAsText` is what the image rule calls to build the alt attribute (src/renderer.ts:109: `slf.renderInlineAsText(token.children!, options, env)`). Nothing else adds code_inline content back.
